title: Design and pharmacodynamics of recombinant NZ2114 histidine mutants with improved activity against methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus.

It might have killed intracellular MRSA via clathrin-mediated endocytosis. Peptide stability: heat-stable after 1 h treatment up to 100oC. resistant to proteases (Trypsin Pepsin Proteinase K). Antimicrobial robustness: pH-insensitive (pH 2-10). NaCl-insensitive (50-500 mM). In vitro Toxicity: up to ~5% hemo.lytic at 128 ug/ml. Recombinant production:yeast:Pichia pastoris: expressed and purified in a fermentor. Animal model:mouse: S. aureus E48-induced mastitis: 100 ug peptide reduced CFU by 3.96 logs (cf.: vancomycin 1.59 logs) ( Wang et al., 2019).
